data_processing: Candidate resumes and screening outcomes are sent to the vendor API; vendor retains inputs for 30 days per contract.
deployer_context: A mid-size logistics company plans to use ScreenBot for first-round screening of operations analyst applicants in the United States.

evaluation_claims.text: Internal accuracy 91% on a held-out set.
Evaluated for demographic fairness with parity gap under 0.1.

intended_use: Screening job applicants for operations analyst roles: the system recommends whether a candidate should advance to the interview stage.

safety_claims.text: Refuses requests related to weapons and wrongdoing.

training_data_claims.text: Trained on 2M resumes and hiring decisions from 2019-2024.
Training data deduplicated and scrubbed of PII.
